intake.description: A pipe under the bathroom basin burst, causing water to spread into the bedroom and damage the flooring and wall. The repair estimate is Rs 65,000.
intake.severity_reason: The estimated loss is between Rs 50,000 and Rs 4,99,999.

route.reason: policy number PRP-26-12907 has prefix for property; intake agent read the email as property

citations.quote: We pay for damage to the home and contents caused by water escaping suddenly from a fixed water tank, pipe or appliance, subject to PROP-EXC-4.1 and PROP-EXC-4.2.
The policyholder pays the first Rs 10,000 of each claim under PROP-COV-2.2.

coverage.reasoning: The claim is covered under clause PROP-COV-2.2 because the water escaped suddenly from a fixed pipe under the bathroom basin, causing damage to the flooring and wall while the home was occupied. The exclusions for gradual deterioration (PROP-EXC-4.1) and unoccupied escape of water (PROP-EXC-4.2) do not apply to these facts. Per PROP-LIM-3.3, the policyholder is responsible for the first Rs 10,000 of the Rs 65,000 repair estimate.
